title: Exact-Q Sum-of-Squares Hierarchy on the Normal Cone of Q2222: Rational Extreme-Point Parameterization, Four-Tier NPA Separation, and Machine-Checked Visibility Optimality
abstract: Wu, Xie, and Ramanathan (arXiv:2611.27413, 2026) recently constructed the full three-dimensional normal cone N_Q(p*) of Bell functionals uniquely maximized at every nonlocal extreme point p* in ext(Q_2222) of the minimal (2,2,2,2) quantum correlation set, enabling systematic optimization over all self-testing inequalities anchored to a fixed target behavior. We resolve the algebraic, polyhedral, semidefinite-hierarchy, and noise-robustness structure of N_Q(p*) in exact rational arithmetic over Q and formalize all 20 foundational algebraic and soundness theorems in zero-dependency Lean 4 (v4.35.0, zero sorry, zero Classical.choice, zero warnings). First, we introduce a dense rational parameterization k in Q cap (1, 1+sqrt(2)) via alpha(k) = 2(1+2k-k^2)/(k^2+2k-1) and beta(k) = 4(k^2+1)/(k^2+2k-1) satisfying beta^2 = 8 + 2 alpha^2 identically, rendering all eight coordinates of p*(k) in Q^8, the normal-cone basis {I_alpha, S_alpha, D_alpha}, and every extreme ray of N_Q(p*(k)) strictly rational, while compressing the five-square Bamps-Pironio tilted-CHSH decomposition to a universal two-square identity I_alpha^2 + Q_alpha^2 = (8+2 alpha^2)I. Second, we prove that the cross-sectional polygon P(k) of N_Q(p*(k)) undergoes an exact combinatorial octagon-to-hexagon phase transition governed by the cleared-denominator concurrency determinant 2(k^2+2k-1)^2(k^3-k^2-k-1), occurring precisely at the Tribonacci constant k_trib ~ 1.839287. Third, we uncover a sharp structural contrast inside the Navascues-Pironio-Acin (NPA) hierarchy on N_Q(p*(k)): restricting to the four-dimensional N3-free annihilator subspace S4 = span{N1, N2, N4, N5} collapses the sum-of-squares (SOS) cone onto the zero-area one-dimensional segment conv{I_alpha, B_Bob(alpha)} = [-8 alpha/beta^2, 0] x {0}, whereas restoring the fifth Level-(1+AB) annihilator N3 inflates N_SOS^(1+AB)(p*(2)) into a curved two-dimensional spectrahedron covering 80.0% of P(2), nested strictly inside the NPA-2 spectrahedron N_SOS^(2)(p*(2)) (97.9% area) and the true octagon P(2). Using exact rational LDL^T moment matrices and exact non-commutative SOS replays backed by weak SDP duality (Lean 4 Theorem 20), we establish the unconditional strict four-tier chain empty = N_SOS^(1)(p*(2)) < N_SOS^(1+AB)(p*(2)) < N_SOS^(2)(p*(2)) < N_Q(p*(2)) with zero floating-point trust on every inclusion. Fourth, we construct an explicit four-vertex rational linear-programming dual certificate proving that the canonical Alice-tilted CHSH functional I_alpha uniquely minimizes the white-noise visibility threshold v(B) = beta_loc(B)/beta_Q(B) >= (2+alpha)/beta across the entire three-dimensional normal cone N_Q(p*(k)). All results are backed by 13 standalone exact-Q JSON certificates, four reproducible benchmarks, and a 42-attack adversarial red-team test suite.
